name: account-room
description: Records each Claude account's rate limit readings, and when this account runs low names the account with the most room, with a Switch button.

readingsRepo.title: Readings repository
readingsRepo.description: The private GitHub repository, as owner/name, where each Mac writes its readings file (readings/<Mac>.json) through gh.

logoutCommand.title: Browser logout command
logoutCommand.description: Shell command that signs claude.ai out in the browser. The default, proven on 2026-10-05 (#659), loads claude.ai's logout page in Google Chrome's last used profile.

signedOutCheck.title: Signed out check
signedOutCheck.description: Shell command that prints exactly 'signed out' and exits 0 once the browser is signed out of claude.ai, and exits 2 printing why when it cannot tell (the browser could not be read); an exit 2 with nothing printed counts as not confirmed. The default, proven on 2026-10-05 (#659), looks for claude.ai's session cookie in Google Chrome's last used profile.
